# errors/from_pagination_role_strategy_mismatch — slice 4 deleted the
# {from_pagination: <role>} discriminator; the same role/strategy mismatch is
# now caught by the cursor-namespace validator (cursor.page is not provided by
# pagination.cursor_token, which only registers cursor.token).

! exec skopos validate -i spec.yml
! stderr .
stdout 'cursor field "page" is not provided by the active pagination/progress strategy'

-- spec.yml --
ir_version: "1"
auth:
  none: {}
requests:
  - method: GET
    path: /api/v1/events
    query:
      cursor: {ref: cursor.page}
response:
  decode: json
  events_at: response.body.events
pagination:
  cursor_token:
    token_at: response.body.next
    send_as: query.cursor
progress:
  stateless: {}
